name: Alien – Visiting. Not Impressed.
title: Alien – Visiting. Not Impressed. Mug
story: This alien mug is for anyone who has been somewhere new and was not impressed: the Monday meeting, the in-laws' holiday dinner, the airport at six in the morning. A small deadpan alien leans on its parked flying saucer with its arms crossed and says it all with two words, which makes it an easy Christmas morning coffee gift or stocking stuffer for the office deadpan in your life.

The print is a teal alien in red sneakers and striped socks, leaning against a cream and coral flying saucer beside a tiny desert motel, a cactus and a crescent moon. VISITING. sits above in dark teal slab capitals and NOT IMPRESSED. below in rust, bold enough to read across a desk, on bright white glossy ceramic.

It matches our Visiting. Not Impressed. oversized hoodie, so the mug and the hoodie make a set for the same unbothered person. Fill it with coffee, tea or cocoa and let the little guy rate your morning, one star at a time. A funny alien mug like this one also works as a desk mug that quietly says what you are thinking in meetings.
joke_a: A tiny alien has traveled across the galaxy to Earth, and its verdict is written right on the mug: VISITING. NOT IMPRESSED. The Visiting. Not Impressed. alien mug from Graphic Tees Co. gives the deadpan friend, the three-star reviewer and the office skeptic a way to say it with every sip of coffee.
